artifacts.summary: Cycle 2 applied the Captain's format correction and scored the assertion sets host-side against the six recorded POC sessions (nothing re-run). Measured: T2 and T4 assertions discriminate (RED fail, GREEN pass); the prescribed T1 pair does not (RED never edited the entity file; it wrote the sed rewrite into ACTION.md and claimed it), so a third assertion is proposed: frontmatter_field decision: hold on ACTION.md, at the cost of one prompt change; designed, not observed; AC-2 falsifier now names it. Two cycle-1 claims corrected: the shared-scratch collision did occur (T2 GREEN read T2 RED's fixture; one workspace filesystem), and the first scorer compared a file to itself (fixed; mutation run flips it). Design consequences: file_unchanged needs a runner-appended sha256sum epilogue because the host cannot hash inside the sandbox; output_contains is scoped to the terminal result string. Round recorder refused: it requires folder-form entity; this workflow keeps flat entities and declares no Feedback Cycles projection, so the revise resolution in the gate record is the durable round record. Open: credential default.
